newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest ups Dixons estimates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest ups Dixons estimates.

text.p: NatWest Securities said on Tuesday it had raised its estimates for pre-tax profit at electrical goods retailer Dixons Group Plc due to a combination of weak competition and strong consumer spending.
NatWest also repeated a "buy" recommendation on Dixons shares, which were up 4-1/2p at 548-1/2 by 0933 GMT.
For the year to April 1997 NatWest raised its pre-tax profit estimate to 195 million stg from 180 million and for 1998 it raised to 225 million stg from 210 million.
"It is a reflection of a combination of happy circumstances," said analyst John Richards at the brokerage. "Competition seems to be weak or dropping away while the general market is picking up."
He said the two factors should be good for profit margins at Dixons, one of Britain's biggest electrical retailers.
